summary.text: Camille Blaylock represents Idaho Senate District 11 and lives in Caldwell; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a first term.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Blaylock was born and raised in Canyon County and graduated from Idaho State University with a degree in communications.
The biography describes Blaylock as an entrepreneur with a background in healthcare technology and corporate event management.
